title: Scaling across difficulty, lab size from 1 to 24

design.question: Across difficulty, lab size from 1 to 24, how much money does each society need, and does the gap between traditional and OSO grow?
design.fixed: the simple model: 12 identical agents, equal money each round, a knowledge reward of 1 per new bit, no validation
design.measure: money needed to solve half the targets

answer: To solve half the targets, traditional needs 8.3× to 10.4× the money OSO needs. By difficulty: growth 2 10.4×, growth 4 8.3×.
caveats: Read off between the two budgets that bracket half the targets, in log budget.
Each difficulty has its own budget range; "> x" means not reached within it.
